Method of Attack: Exploits Microsoft Office zero-day vulnerability to execute malicious PowerShell commands via Microsoft Diagnostic Tool (MSDT) using the ms-msdt URI protocol scheme
Uses malicious Word or RTF documents with remote template feature to fetch HTML that loads and executes PowerShell code
Bypasses Windows Defender detection and does not require macros enabled
Zero-click exploitation by selecting malicious RTF document
Creates child processes of msdt.exe and sdiagnhost.exe with conhost.exe child processes
Impacted Systems: Office Pro Plus April version on Windows 11 May updates
Attack Vector: Opening or previewing malicious Word or RTF document leveraging ms-msdt URI scheme
Remote template loading of malicious HTML from remote server (e.g., xmlformats.com domain)
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious Word/RTF documents submitted to VirusTotal from IP in Belarus
Remote HTML document from xmlformats[.]com domain (no longer loading)
Child processes msdt.exe, sdiagnhost.exe, conhost.exe spawned during exploitation
